duas.name: Ayat al-Kursi
duas.arabic_text: أَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. اَللّٰهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَّلَا نَوْمٌ ، لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمٰـوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْأَرْضِ ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِىْ يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ، يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ، وَلَا يُحِيْطُوْنَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ، وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰـوٰتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَئُوْدُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ، وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيْمُ.
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina-sh-Shayṭāni-r-rajīm. Allāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa-l-Ḥayyu-l-Qayyūm, lā ta'khudhuhū sinatuw-wa lā nawm, lahū mā fi-s-samāwāti wa mā fi-l-arḍ, man dhā'lladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shay'im-min ʿilmihī illā bi-mā shā', wasiʿa kursiyyuhu-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, wa lā ya'ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā wa Huwa-l-ʿAlliyu-l-ʿAẓīm.
duas.english_translation: I seek the protection of Allah from the accursed Shayṭān. Allah, there is no god worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, The Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him Alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Magnificent. (2:255)
duas.benefit_virtue: If one reads Āyah al-Kursī in the morning, they will be protected from devils till the evening.

duas.name: 3 Quls
duas.arabic_text: أَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. اَللّٰهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَّلَا نَوْمٌ ، لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمٰـوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْأَرْضِ ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِىْ يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ، يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ، وَلَا يُحِيْطُوْنَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ، وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰـوٰتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَئُوْدُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ، وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيْمُ.
duas.transliteration: Bismi-llāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm. Qul Huwa-llāhu Aḥad. Allāhu-ṣ-Ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakul-lahū kufuwan aḥad. Bismi-llāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbi-l-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Min sharri-n-naffāthāti fi-l-ʿuqad. Min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad. Bismi-llāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbi-n-nās. Maliki-n-nās. Ilāh-hin-nās. Min sharri-l-waswāsi-l-khannās. Al-ladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri-n-nās. Mina-l-jinnati wa-n-nās.
duas.english_translation: Say, He is Allah, the One... Say, I seek protection of the Lord of the daybreak... Say, I seek protection of the Lord of mankind...
duas.benefit_virtue: Reciting Sūrah al-Ikhlās and al-Mu'awwidhatayn three times in the morning and evening will suffice you in all respects.

duas.name: Sayyid al-Istighfar
duas.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّيْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ، خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ، أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ ، أَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِيْ ، فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma Anta Rabbī, lā ilāha illā Ant, khalaqtanī wa ana ʿabduk, wa ana ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā'staṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū'u laka bi niʿmatika ʿalayya wa abū'u laka bi-dhambī fa-ghfir lī fa-innahū lā yaghfiru-dh-dhunūba illā Ant.
duas.english_translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god worthy of worship except You. You have created me, and I am Your slave...
duas.benefit_virtue: Whoever says it during the day with firm belief in it and dies on the same day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise.

duas.name: Protection From Anxiety, Laziness, Debt etc
duas.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min-l-hammi wa-l-ḥazan, wa aʿūdhu bika min-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasal, wa aʿūdhu bika min-l-jubni wa-l-bukhl, wa aʿūdhu bika min ghalabati-d-dayni wa qahri-r-rijāl.
duas.english_translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection from anxiety and grief. I seek Your protection from inability and laziness...
duas.benefit_virtue: Recite it in the morning and evening, Allah would remove his worries and settle his debts.

duas.name: Evening Declaration of Faith
duas.arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilayka al-maṣīr.
duas.english_translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and to You is our return.
duas.benefit_virtue: Affirms reliance upon Allah in life and death.

duas.name: Sayyid al-Istighfar (Evening)
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta Rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa ana ʿabduk, wa ana ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā'staṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū'u laka bi niʿmatika ʿalayya wa abū'u bi dhanbī, faghfir lī fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā anta.
duas.english_translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. None has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant... So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.benefit_virtue: Whoever says it in the evening with firm belief and dies that night will enter Paradise.

duas.name: Seeking Protection from Harm
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa ismihi shay’un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā’i wa huwa as-Samīʿul-ʿAlīm.
duas.english_translation: In the Name of Allah with whose Name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
duas.benefit_virtue: Nothing will harm the one who recites it three times in the evening.

duas.name: Hasbiya Allah (Reliance Upon Allah)
duas.arabic_text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-ʿArshil-ʿAẓīm.
duas.english_translation: Allah is sufficient for me. None has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
duas.benefit_virtue: Whoever recites it seven times in the evening, Allah will suffice him in all matters.

duas.name: Seeking Well-being
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā anta. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, lā ilāha illā anta.
duas.english_translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body, hearing and sight... I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty and the punishment of the grave.
duas.benefit_virtue: Protection in health, faith and from the punishment of the grave.

duas.name: Seeking Refuge in Allah’s Perfect Words
duas.arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhi t-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
duas.english_translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.benefit_virtue: Protection from all forms of harm and evil.

duas.name: Dua Before Eating
duas.benefit_virtue: Brings blessings in food and prevents Shaytan from partaking in it.

duas.name: Dua After Eating
duas.arabic_text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّٰهِ ٱلَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillāhi alladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
duas.english_translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or might from myself.
duas.benefit_virtue: Whoever says this will have his past sins forgiven.

duas.name: Dua Before Sleeping
duas.english_translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.benefit_virtue: Recited before sleeping, entrusting one's soul to Allah.

duas.name: Dua Upon Waking
duas.arabic_text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّٰهِ ٱلَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillāhi alladhī aḥyā-nā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhi-n-nushūr.
duas.english_translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
duas.benefit_virtue: Expresses gratitude for being granted another day of life.

duas.name: Dua When Leaving Home
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّٰهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّٰهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu ʿalā Allāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
duas.english_translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
duas.benefit_virtue: The person is protected, guided and defended.

duas.name: Dua When Entering Home
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi walajnā, wa bismillāhi kharajnā, wa ʿalā rabbinā tawakkalnā.
duas.english_translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.
duas.benefit_virtue: Brings blessings into the home and prevents Shaytan from entering.

duas.name: Dua for Seeking Knowledge
duas.english_translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.benefit_virtue: A supplication from the Qur’an asking Allah to increase beneficial knowledge.

duas.name: Dua for Protection (Morning & Evening)
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ ٱسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa ismihi shay’un fi-l-arḍi wa lā fi-s-samā’, wa huwa-s-Samīʿu-l-ʿAlīm.
duas.english_translation: In the Name of Allah with whose Name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
duas.benefit_virtue: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening will not be harmed.

duas.name: Dua for Barakah in Time
duas.benefit_virtue: Asking Allah to put barakah in one’s daily schedule and activities.
